name: Concave World: Free Jungle
desc:
Beautifully restored "Free Jungle," the iconic anime scene from The Curved World! Immerse yourself in the immersive anime atmosphere! Participate in events, unlock limited character skins, accessory benefits, and more!
[Game Features]
- Explore the "Free Jungle" anime scene
- Immerse yourself in anime classic soundtrack
- Parkour map to explore jungle scenery
- Collect referee balls to unlock limited benefits
[Limited Reward]
- Character Accessories: Vector Arrow, Moonblade, Fire Shear
- Character Skin: Gray

Colored Eggs: More scenes and gameplay will be fully open in December, and clues are hidden in the game, look forward to!
